sources.title: Salesforce lays off more employees in new round of cuts
sources.description: Salesforce announces another round of layoffs impacting Agentforce, Mulesoft, Marketing Cloud teams amid growing AI-driven transformation.

sources.title: Salesforce quietly laid off workers in a new round of cuts - AOL
sources.description: Salesforce trims staff in marketing, product, and data teams, affecting fewer than 1,000 roles. The company recently had a leadership overhaul.

sources.title: Salesforce cuts 4,000 jobs due to AI, CEO says
sources.description: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff said AI automation helped the software company cut its customer support headcount from 9,000 to 5,000 human workers.

sources.title: Salesforce to cut workforce by 10% after hiring 'too many people' during the pandemic | TechCrunch
sources.description: Salesforce is cutting its workforce by 10%, impacting more than 7,000 employees, while it will also shutter offices in "certain markets."

sources.title: Salesforce to cut 10% of workforce in latest tech layoffs
sources.description: It said it needs to cut costs after rapid pandemic hiring left it with 'too many people' amid an economic slowdown.

sources.title: Salesforce to chop 10% of workforce in restructuring plan
sources.description: CRM specialist to 'reduce operating costs, improve operating margins' as pandemic catches up with tech industry
